invalid_attempt.invalidity: The recursive forbidden-signature grep opened FORBIDDEN-INFRASTRUCTURE-SIGNATURES.txt inside its own search root before scanning. GNU grep detected its output as an input file and returned status 2. The wrapper converted that scanner error to a false forbidden-signature failure.

correction.change: Write grep output to an external mktemp path and atomically move it into the run directory only after recursive scanning completes.

decision: Preserve the invalid attempt, rerun the complete unchanged qualification under the corrected v3a1 provenance label, and continue fail-closed.
